meta.title: Casa Escondida — Hybrid AI Reservation Intake & Edge BFF Architecture

views.label: 1. Edge Intake & Security Gate
views.note: WhatsApp and Web Console requests pass HMAC verification, WAMID deduplication, and Redis phone locks at the Hono Edge BFF.

views.label: 2. Hybrid AI Extractor Pod
views.note: Pass 1 (Trip JSON) + Pass 2 (Guest Manifest) run in parallel with a 60s circuit breaker and deterministic Math & Fact Gates.

views.label: 3. Verified Output & Staff Alerts
views.note: Once all 6 booking slots are captured, the pod returns a verified reply to the guest and flags Staff Alerts for downstream ERP handoff.

cards.title: 1. Edge Security & Concurrency Control
items: Meta Cloud API webhook verified via X-Hub-Signature-256 before parsing
Upstash Redis claims WAMID fence token and serializes turns per phone number
Coalesces rapid guest messages and supports instant 'reset' commands

cards.title: 2. Resilient Dual-Pass Hybrid AI Pod
items: Runs Pass 1 (Trip JSON) + Isolated Pass 2 (Guests, Check-In, Dive Window) in parallel
60s circuit breaker between DeepSeek Flash and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite prevents timeouts
Deterministic Reconciler resolves mid-chat headcount changes and split-day diving

cards.title: 3. Fact Gate & Staff Alert Handoff
items: NEVER RE-ASK rule ensures the bot never asks for a field already stated
Post-generation Fact Gate blocks unauthorized price promises or invented discounts
Emits structured Trip JSON + Staff Alerts (30% partner discount, split dive schedule)
